title: Epistle sentence skeleton
subtitle: Find the main assertion in a dense sentence.
overview: Epistle prose can delay the main verb with greetings, prepositional phrases, and modifiers. Do not translate from left to right until you find the skeleton.
Mark the finite verb, its subject, and its complements; then attach every phrase to that core.

items.grc: εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
items.en: Blessed is the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

items.grc: ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ πνευματικῇ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ.
items.en: The one who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ.
